thread:
lisa: Heads up — after the recent package.json exports change, a couple of our sample apps fail only when running in the edge runtime (Vercel/Cloudflare). Local Node (CJS/Node ESM) seems fine.
jamie: ugh, seen that. what's the exact error in edge? :thinking:
lisa: Error is: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` when importing the top-level package. In the edge environment it tries to resolve `./index` but our exports map only has nested paths. stack trace snippet:
```
Error: Cannot find module 'redwood-sdk'
    at Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Function.Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```
alex: hmm, edge runtimes do their own resolve heuristics. Did we include both "import" and "require" targets in exports? and types?
lisa: current exports in the package are minimal — we switched to a strict exports map during the packaging PR. Example of what we shipped (simplified):
```
"exports": {
  "./client": "./dist/esm/client.js",
  "./server": "./dist/cjs/server.js"
}
```
jamie: right — that blocks bare import of the package root ("import Redwood from 'redwood'"), which many sample apps use. Edge builds sometimes expect a root entry.
miriam: also seeing TypeScript complaints in downstream repos: "Could not find a declaration file for module 'redwood'" — we forgot the `types` pointer for the root export.
lisa: proposed quick fix for packaging:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./client": "./dist/esm/client.js",
  "./server": "./dist/cjs/server.js"
}
```
alex: that looks good. Also consider preserving legacy `main` and `module` fields for older bundlers that don't respect exports map.
jamie: +1. And add a small test in sample-apps that builds+runs in a Cloudflare Workers-like edge runner to catch regressions.
lisa: I'll open two PRs: one to fix the packaging script in sdk repo, and one to update sample-apps imports to use named entrypoints where appropriate. I'll add a test job to CI that uses `esbuild --platform=neutral` + wrangler dev to smoke edge import resolution.
miriam: can you also add a changelog note? customer-facing sample apps might break during upgrade if they rely on root import.
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: run packaging PR -> build artifacts -> publish to staging registry -> update sample-apps -> run edge smoke tests.
lisa: thanks — will aim for PRs today. tagging @eng-ml and @devex for visibility. if anyone has other edge caveats (like needing .mjs ext or package.json "type":"module" interplay), drop them here.
alex: one more gotcha: some edge bundlers ignore `require` target and always prefer `import` — make sure our ESM build is fully compatible (no top-level CommonJS bits). Also double-check source maps for ease of debugging.
jamie: noted. I'll add a quick lint that checks exports map has root entry + types pointer.
lisa: perfect. I'll update the SDK release notes and link the PRs here once they're up. Thanks!
